aboutDescription: I’m a Full-Stack Developer, and my main stack is Python, Django, TypeScript, and React. I bring practical experience from software projects in my previous role as a Product Engineer. I quickly adapt to new technologies and actively use AI to build efficient, high-quality solutions.
contactMeText: Feel free to contact me for opportunities in web development. I bring hands-on experience from real projects and a solid workflow with Git to contribute effectively to your team.
contactConsentSuffix: and agree to the processing of my data as described there.
privacyPolicyIntro: This privacy policy explains what personal data may be processed when you visit this portfolio website or use the contact form, and for what purpose that processing takes place.
privacyPolicyControllerText: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is Mark Corzilius. If you have questions about privacy or data protection, please use the contact options provided on this website.
privacyPolicyCollectedText: When you use the contact form, the data you enter, such as your name, email address, and message, is processed. When you visit the website, technical data required for delivery, stability, and security, such as IP address, browser information, and server log data, may also be processed automatically.
privacyPolicyPurposeText: Contact form data is processed only to handle and answer your request. Technical data is processed to deliver the website, maintain security, prevent misuse, and ensure stable operation.
privacyPolicyRetentionText: Personal data is stored only for as long as necessary to process your request or to comply with legal obligations. Technical logs are retained only for a limited period when required for security and operation.
privacyPolicyHostingText: This website may be hosted by an external technical provider. In that case, the provider processes technical data only to make the website available securely and reliably.
privacyPolicyRightsText: Depending on the applicable law, you may have the right to request access to your personal data, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, data portability, or to object to processing. You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority.
privacyPolicySecurityText: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are used to protect personal data against loss, unauthorized access, and misuse.
privacyPolicyChangesText: This privacy policy may be updated if legal requirements or the functionality of this website change. The current version published on this page applies.
